Once upon a time, Timmy was flying in the sky. He saw a big bird with a broken wing. Timmy was very sad because he was not careful not to fly in the sky. He missed his bird friend the boy because he was a bit too!

But then, Timmy saw a bird flying in the sky. He wanted to watch the bird fly and make a new friend. Timmy was happy because he thought the bird was really nice. He decided to make a nest for the bird and share it with him. The bird was very happy and flew away. Timmy felt good that he could help the bird
